**Finding: COMPLIANT (preferred position met).**

- **No take-or-pay exposure.** Searches for minimum/commit/volume/purchase/shortfall/forecast terms returned no commitment provision binding Sanofi.
- **Payments are event- and sales-driven only:** §9.1 upfront, §9.2 milestones (one-time, first achievement only, aggregate cap $520M), §9.3 royalties on actual Net Sales with reduction mechanics.
- **Supply (§7.3)** merely contemplates a future negotiated Supply Agreement — no committed quantities or requirements obligation; **§8.3** distributorships run in our favour.
- **§5.7 diligence and the milestone/royalty consideration** are not volume commitments and are left to their own rules to avoid double-flagging.

No redline proposed.
